caption: AI hype vs real usefulness in business isn't a guess. These prompts help you judge tools by impact, not buzz. Use them in your next vendor review and share results. Which tool passed your practical test? #AIforBusiness #PracticalAI #EntrepreneurTools

slides.title: AI hype vs usefulness
slides.body: AI hype inflates tool value; focus on real impact. Try these 5 prompts.

slides.title: 1. Quick Value Check
slides.body: Rate each tool in [tools] by RealImpact vs Hype. Return a table with Tool, RealImpact, HypeScore, Recommendation.

slides.title: 2. Compare Tools
slides.body: Compare tools in [tools] by RealImpact minus Hype. Output a ranked list of Tools with scores.

slides.title: 3. Risk Flags
slides.body: For each tool in [tools], list 2 red flags if required data is missing; provide mitigation notes.

slides.title: 4. Cost vs Benefit
slides.body: Estimate monthly cost and impact for [tools]. Return a decision note on whether to adopt.

slides.title: 5. Action Roadmap
slides.body: Create a 2-week trial plan for [tool], with milestones, owners, and success criteria.

slides.title: Measure value, not hype
